title: FOMC moves ES 13 pts on the 1m statement bar

hero.caption: That's the average 1-minute release candle range on FOMC statements for ES. **Max 65 pts** in 2024.

chart.label: Release-bar range, year by year
chart.note: 2024 had the biggest single max at 65 pts, 2022 high avg too.

useIt: I check FOMC 1m range before the 14:00 statement to know the initial pop size on ES. ~13 pts avg, 2022-24 showed 28-21 avg with 65 max — size for the bar then watch follow through. The variants here are 1m only unlike the NQ multi-window version.
